title: 第十二章 乖女孩，是不可以分神的
slug: 和情敌共感后傲娇竹马火葬场了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

霍宴年的瞳孔微微缩了一下。

但那抹讶异转瞬即逝，快得像根本没存在过。

他弯起唇角，笑意没有到达眼底，反而让他的表情变得更难捉摸。

下一秒，他扣住她的腰，将她整个人抱着站起。

天璇地转间，夏暮已经被摁在了那全景落地窗前。

她长睫微垂，扫过玻璃，看向脚下的车水马龙，以及走过路过的人群。

即便知道这是单向玻璃......但在这种情况下，她依旧抑制不住地指尖轻颤。

感官，仿佛被无限放大。

冰冷的玻璃，与身后滚丨烫的胸丨膛，将她jia在中间，简直要将她逼疯！

偏偏，她的视线正正对着那块，还在循环播放广告的LED屏。

薄璟琛正低头给苏苒整理被风吹乱的发丝，动作温柔。

夏暮咬了咬牙。

她真是被霍宴年刚才的演技骗了......

他才不是什么良人，他简直坏透了！

她下意识想移开视线。

一只温热的大手从侧面覆上来，严严实实地遮住了她的眼睛。

“乖女孩，是不可以分神的。”霍宴年的声音贴着她的耳廓响起。

低哑，带着点漫不经心的不满。

他的拇指轻轻擦过她的颧骨，像是在描摹她的轮廓，“就现在，想着我。”

视野被他的掌心完全占据，黑暗中其他感官变得格外敏锐。

她的脊背，能清晰感受到他呼吸时胸膛的起伏，以及他指尖残留的雪松香气......

薄璟琛正半倚坐在会议桌的主位，指尖夹着一支钢笔，有意无意地轻点着会议桌。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Huo Yannian's pupils shrank slightly.

But the surprise was fleeting, as if it had never existed at all.

He curved the corners of his lips, and the smile did not reach his eyes, but instead made his expression more unpredictable.

The next second, he grabbed her waist, held her whole body and stood up.

In the blink of an eye, Xia Mu was pressed in front of the panoramic floor-to-ceiling window.

She lowered her long eyelashes slightly and scanned the glass, looking at the busy traffic under her feet and the people passing by.

Even though she knew it was one-way glass...but in this case, she still couldn't help but tremble at her fingertips.

The senses seem to be infinitely magnified.

The cold glass and the hot chest behind her trapped her in the middle, driving her crazy!

However, her eyes were facing the LED screen that was still playing advertisements in a loop.

Bo Jingchen was lowering his head to tidy up Su Ran's hair that was messed up by the wind, with gentle movements.

Xia Mu gritted her teeth.

She was really deceived by Huo Yannian's acting skills just now...

He is not a good person, he is simply evil!

She subconsciously wanted to look away.

A warm hand came up from the side, covering her eyes tightly.

"Good girl, you can't be distracted." Huo Yannian's voice sounded close to her ear.

Low voice, with a bit of casual dissatisfaction.

His thumb gently brushed her cheekbone, as if tracing her outline, "Just now, think of me."

His field of vision was completely occupied by his palm, and other senses became particularly sharp in the darkness.

On her back, she could clearly feel the rise and fall of his chest as he breathed, as well as the lingering scent of cedar on his fingertips...

Bo Jingchen was half leaning on the main seat of the conference table, holding a pen between his fingertips, tapping the conference table intentionally or unintentionally.
